children: Leroy T. Carlson Jr., a Director and Vice Chair, sold common shares in transactions reported on September 11, 2026. The reporting person sold 77,100 shares at an average price of $37.454149 per share. The total sale proceeds reported were $2,964,811. Following the reported transactions, Carlson directly owns 480,360 common shares and indirectly owns 2,907,731 common shares (2,828,788 and 78,943 reported via family and trusts).
